study.question: Observed successful full-validation runs at the frozen single seed: incumbent g0-r0069-buy_summary_direction click AUC 0.668531811, cart/fav/buy 0.803864431/0.814572349/0.828078140, 32192421 parameters, wall389.486s. g0-r0079-feedback_additive click0.666275380, auxiliary0.828375651/0.848558523/0.847685356; g0-r0079-match_capacity click0.667807491, auxiliary0.816780072/0.834655136/0.845214920. Both extended sources use32206757 parameters and identical branch structure. Thus auxiliary gains accompany click losses, larger for aligned feedback. These observations do not measure gradient conflict. g0-r0079-feedback_rotated click0.667328231 also loses to incumbent but exceeds aligned; this is counterevidence to simple alignment benefit. No execution error or missing data explains these successful negatives. Does blocking only the additional auxiliary extension-to-context gradient recover click quality while retaining feedback information and auxiliary gains, and is any recovery specific to the feedback source?
study.hypothesis: The added task-conditioned feedback covariance branch can help auxiliary prediction while its extra auxiliary updates to shared context embeddings harm click learning. A train-only stop-gradient at that branch context input may recover click AUC without removing auxiliary branch parameter training or changing its forward representation. Expected larger recovery for aligned feedback than match source; this is unverified, and direct gradient conflict has not been measured.

nearest_work.difference: Retain complete additive branch and common support. Only add a train-time auxiliary context-edge gate; factorial source control and replays distinguish generic branch damage from feedback-specific effect.
Incumbent uses five detail summaries and context product with selective buy summary VJP, without the added covariance branch. It remains the best known validation reference.

Inspected pinned benchmark forward lines123..170: task-mask pooled sequence hubs and repeated categorical/sequence/task interaction. Here compressed coefficient covariance remains an additive branch with one upstream gradient gate; no hub stack reproduction. Original INFNet paper is provenance-only and unverified.

Read archived primary local-activation motivation; inherit adapted target-conditioned scorer/Dice through local lineage. New test concerns auxiliary gradient ownership in the existing compressed model, not a DIN reproduction or novelty claim.

inherited_components: Entire archived r0079 source, embedding tables, compressed scorer, support folding and pruned eval
All five target/ordinal detail summaries and task adapters
Context queries, blockwise nonlinear context-history products and zero-initialized additive source branch
Original auxiliary input/scorer detachment, tower/context gates, native click/cart/fav and unchanged first-order buy summary VJP
Default host training loss; no new parameters, state, RNG, optimizer or data
study.proposed_difference: One boolean block_aux_extension_context_grad gates context.detach() before extension context-query projection during training on labels other than is_click. Original adapter/context-history/tower paths unchanged. Two-by-two source(task_aligned/match_duplicate) x context-gradient(allowed/blocked), with allowed cells replaying archived successful negative trials. Gate deliberately leaves auxiliary query-weight gradients active.
predictions: At common state, gate cells have identical train/eval predictions and all non-context-input extension parameter gradients; auxiliary extension context VJP vanishes only in blocked cell, while original auxiliary context routes remain.
On full validation, feedback blocked-minus-allowed click AUC is positive; a feedback-specific transfer account predicts a positive difference-in-differences against the match pair.
Useful complementarity requires feedback_context_blocked to exceed both matched match_context_blocked and incumbent0.668531811 at justified measured cost; auxiliary gains alone are insufficient.
falsifiers: Failed fixed-source forward/buffer/state/RNG parity or incorrect gradient ownership invalidates mechanistic interpretation; no training outcome can rescue that integrity failure.
If allowed-cell replay fails beyond documented nondeterminism, resolve reproduction discrepancy before attributing a gate effect.
If feedback blocked-minus-allowed AUC is nonpositive after valid execution, the proposed context-edge repair is unsupported for this implementation.
If both sources improve similarly or feedback does not beat match, feedback-specific benefit is unsupported.
If best candidate fails to exceed incumbent or measured cost is unjustified, useful click complementarity objective remains unmet; do not access withheld data to choose a winner.
alternative_explanations: Feedback covariance adds noise/scale instability or overfits common-support examples independently of shared context transfer.
Both sources change global dense clipping through added parameter gradients; detaching sparse context inputs need not change initial dense clipping, but later trajectories can.

Auxiliary task-specific query weights are shared between original and new product branches within task and still update in every cell; remaining effects may be mediated by these rather than context embeddings.
Feedback/auxiliary label semantics and rare common support may limit predictive value under offline visibility; no production causal claim.
Observed tradeoff may reflect ordinary optimization or seed/validation selection variation rather than gradient direction conflict.

variants.note:

Host prerequisites remain mandatory and unmeasured locally: verify frozen dataset/released parquet digests, protocol/source/loader identities, visibility and readiness receipts. New gate routes by label identity, never fixed index, historical action value or current label. For allowed cells require common-state forward/buffer/all-parameter-gradient and one-step parity with archived r0079 sources within predeclared FP32/BF16 tolerance. Do not infer path isolation from total context gradient, which retains inherited auxiliary paths. Do not require total optimizer-step parity between gate cells: shared embedding updates and later learning differ, and global dense clipping can mediate indirect effects. No direct new shared-item/scorer path is opened. Zero initialized extension outputs initially make the gated gradient zero in both cells; a zero-only test is insufficient. Gate is applied BEFORE query linear projection; it blocks context input gradient only, keeping task-specific query weights trainable.

Match and feedback share coefficient norms/common support but not realized summary norms or gradients. Gate cells share forward arithmetic, not necessarily backward runtime.
